collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager is now the best at their work in the village, and a friend asks how it feels: answer honestly, or say it is wonderful.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After many years, everyone agrees that (subject) is now the best at (subject.his/her) work in the whole village. Elders ask (subject.his/her) advice. Apprentices watch (subject.his/her) hands. It's what (subject.he/she) wanted since (subject.he/she) was young. This evening (subject.he/she) is sitting outside, and (friend) asks how it feels.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Strange," says (subject). "I thought I'd feel finished. I don't. I keep noticing things I still can't do." (friend) laughs. "Isn't that good?" (subject) thinks about it. "I suppose it means it isn't over." (subject.He/she) goes to bed thinking about a tricky thing (subject.he/she) wants to try tomorrow.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Wonderful," says (subject), and means it. (subject.He/she) lets (subject.him/her)self be proud for a whole evening, without adding any "but." It's a rare feeling. (subject.He/she) sits with it for a long time. Tomorrow there will be more to learn. Tonight (subject.he/she) is simply, quietly, good at something, and that's enough.
